title: ЗА + accusative: In an hour (it took)

blocks.text: ЗА + Accusative denotes the time that it takes to accomplish an action.

items: in an hour (it took an hour)

items.text: The preposition ЗА + Acc. denotes the time that it takes to accomplish an action.
„ЗА + Acc.“ is also used in combination with „ДО + Gen.“ to denote the time of one event taking place before some other event: Он умер за год до войны.

blocks.text: DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 77. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.
